plugins.name: dsh-immune-system
plugins.description: Self-evolving pitfall immunity: capture every failed-then-fixed tool episode, distil it into a reusable antibody, and inject the relevant ones before the agent repeats the mistake.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 自进化避坑免疫：捕获每次「失败→修复」的工具调用，蒸馏成可复用的抗体，并在下次遇到同样场景前注入，避免重蹈覆辙。
